# WebView2.Win32 markup reference

Fluent extensions declared by the `Aprillz.MewUI.WebView2.Win32` package.

### WebView2

Receiver: `WebView2`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BrowserExecutableFolder(string value)` | `BrowserExecutableFolder` | Sets the folder of the WebView2 runtime to use, or null for the installed runtime; throws InvalidOperationException when set after the environment is created. |
| `ControllerOptions(WebViewControllerOptions value)` | `ControllerOptions` | Sets the options used when creating the WebView2 controller, or null for the defaults; throws InvalidOperationException when set after the controller is created. |
| `DefaultBackgroundColor(Color? value)` | `DefaultBackgroundColor` | Sets the default background color of the WebView controller; null keeps the WebView2 default, and a translucent color throws ArgumentException. |
| `OnContentLoading(Action<WebViewContentLoadingEventArgs> handler)` | `event ContentLoading` | Subscribes handler to ContentLoading. Occurs when content starts loading. |
| `OnCoreWebView2InitializationCompleted(Action<WebViewInitializationCompletedEventArgs> handler)` | `event CoreWebView2InitializationCompleted` | Subscribes handler to CoreWebView2InitializationCompleted. Occurs when the CoreWebView2 initialization has completed. |
| `OnDocumentTitleChanged(Action<string> handler)` | `event DocumentTitleChanged` | Subscribes handler to DocumentTitleChanged. Occurs when the document title changes. |
| `OnFrameNavigationCompleted(Action<WebViewNavigationCompletedEventArgs> handler)` | `event FrameNavigationCompleted` | Subscribes handler to FrameNavigationCompleted. Occurs when frame navigation has completed. |
| `OnNavigationCompleted(Action<WebViewNavigationCompletedEventArgs> handler)` | `event NavigationCompleted` | Subscribes handler to NavigationCompleted. Occurs when navigation has completed. |
| `OnNavigationStarting(Action<WebViewNavigationStartingEventArgs> handler)` | `event NavigationStarting` | Subscribes handler to NavigationStarting. Occurs when navigation starts. |
| `OnNewWindowRequested(Action<WebViewNewWindowRequestedEventArgs> handler)` | `event NewWindowRequested` | Subscribes handler to NewWindowRequested. Occurs when a new window is requested. |
| `OnSourceChanged(Action<WebViewSourceChangedEventArgs> handler)` | `event SourceChanged` | Subscribes handler to SourceChanged. Occurs when Source changes. |
| `OnWebMessageReceived(Action<WebViewWebMessageReceivedEventArgs> handler)` | `event WebMessageReceived` | Subscribes handler to WebMessageReceived. Occurs when a message is received from the web content. |
| `OnZoomFactorChanged(Action handler)` | `event ZoomFactorChanged` | Subscribes handler to ZoomFactorChanged. Occurs when ZoomFactor changes. |
| `Options(WebViewEnvironmentOptions value)` | `Options` | Sets the environment options, or null for the defaults; throws InvalidOperationException when set after the environment is created. |
| `Source(Uri value)` | `Source` | Sets the URI of the top-level document. |
| `UseSharedEnvironment(bool value = true)` | `UseSharedEnvironment` | Sets whether this control shares one WebView2 environment with the other controls that do; throws InvalidOperationException when set after the environment is created. |
| `UserDataFolder(string value)` | `UserDataFolder` | Sets the user data folder, or null for the default; throws InvalidOperationException when set after the environment is created. |
| `ZoomFactor(double value)` | `ZoomFactor` | Sets the zoom factor for the WebView. |
